Subject: Trial extension + credits request

Hi Mina,

- a $25k credit grant to cover integration re-runs and eval tokens

Appreciate it,
Liam

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval needed: Nebulon Labs — trial extension + credits + discount

Marissa / Aditya,

Summary: Nebulon Labs (Liam) is requesting a 30-day extension, $25k in free credits, and a 20% first-invoice discount. They've hit an integration blocker (schema drift) that prevented a representative evaluation during the original trial window. We have momentum: the model performance impressed their ML team.

Why approve: conversion probability is high if we remove the integration friction. Nebulon is targeting a 6-month paid commit at small scale (they've verbally confirmed intent). The competitive risk is medium — they are evaluating two other vendors.

Ask (recommendation):
- Approve 1 month trial extension (ends 2026-05-20)
- Grant $15,000 in evaluation credits (covering re-runs and embeddings) — recommend below-request amount to protect economics
- Approve a 15% first-invoice discount (we can increase on a clear commit + seat-based upsell)

Conditions:
- Require signed SOW (attached: Nebulon_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf) that converts to a minimum 6-month paid contract within 45 days of the extended trial end, else credits reclaimed/voided
- Procurement to receive the SOW and the procurement questions doc (attached)

Financial impact: ~15k credits + 15% discount on first invoice (expected ~ $35k ARR initial commit) — downside small, upside: higher probability of conversion and case study.

Attachments: Nebulon_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf; Nebulon_Procurement_Questions.xlsx

Can you both approve or suggest modifications? Time-sensitive — Liam asked for a response by end of Tue 2026-04-13.

Thanks,
Mina
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Nebulon Labs — trial extension + credits + discount

Mina —Thanks for the packet and rationale. I agree we should be pragmatic here to preserve momentum. Approve with one change: bump the credit grant to $18,000 (still short of their ask but closer) and keep the 15% first-invoice discount.

Make sure the SOW includes a clear conversion milestone (signed paid contract for >=6 months within 45 days of extension end) and a clause for credit clawback if they do not convert. Also ask Legal to confirm the wording in the SOW — cc procurement on the final.

Aditya — if you agree, Mina can push this to Liam and lock in the commit language.

Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
